description: Experimental TF3 multiplayer prototype. Probe v50 / bridge v14: automatic IPv6 router pinholes, verified Windows rules and reliable first-world readiness. Optional TLS Internet invitations over IPv6 or IPv4 with UPnP/manual router forwarding. The launcher tunnels game UDP and parallel save transfer through one authenticated TCP port; VPN sessions exchange builds, lines, vehicles, loans and live calendar speed. v48 holds both games while either pause menu is open, preserves speed across overlapping menu/action holds and streams savegame data continuously with transfer diagnostics. v47 prevents automatic action pauses from leaking into shared user speed and keeps ordered sessions running despite large time offsets. v46 schedules subsidy acceptance/decline with native upfront rewards, shares company names and labels economy failures. v45 preserves the native next-reachable-stop choice, fixes GUI callback data and reports line path failures. v44 fixes world-entry failure in the main GUI vehicle hooks by replacing unsupported log.info with protected stdout logging. v43 reports failed replays on both PCs, reads non-enumerable world components through alternative indexes and intercepts commands in native vehicle windows via the main GUI extension. v42 replaces industry field modules through native commands before station builds and transfers rail bridge and tunnel resource types. v41 preserves rail junctions and guards replay stages. World differences remain diagnostic; a shared save is reloaded only on explicit resync request. Both PCs need the same package. Real two-PC regression tests are still required.
name: Multiplayer Probe (dev)
summary: Logs the TF3 Lua sandbox and engine API for multiplayer research.
